edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable by the owned constructor.
The constructor mints the whole supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
_transfer reads LockList[msg.sender] to decide whether the caller is locked.
transfer passes msg.sender as the _from argument of _transfer.
burn debits balanceOf[msg.sender] and totalSupply on behalf of the caller.
burnFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is consumed.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender for allowance bookkeeping.
approve writes _allowance[msg.sender][_spender] and reads balanceOf[msg.sender].
approveAndCall forwards msg.sender as the _from argument of the external receiveApproval call.
The onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner before transferOwnership executes.
UserLock is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier evaluating msg.sender.
LockTokens is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier evaluating msg.sender.
UnLockTokens is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier evaluating msg.sender.
The owned constructor initialises the privileged owner variable.
transferOwnership overwrites the privileged owner variable.
The token constructor assigns the scaled initial supply to totalSupply.
The token constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
The token constructor stores the token name.
The token constructor stores the token symbol.
decimals is used as the exponent when scaling the initial supply.
The constructor executes the unchecked multiplication that scales initialSupply.
initialSupply * 10 ** decimals can silently overflow before being stored in totalSupply.
The ETOR constructor executes the unchecked multiplication that builds the supply argument.
9900000000 * 1 ** decimals can overflow and produce a wrong totalSupply.
The ETOR constructor supplies the value that ultimately becomes totalSupply.
The ETOR constructor invokes the TOKENERC20 base constructor.
_transfer reads and writes balanceOf for the sender and the recipient.
_transfer checks LockList for sender, recipient and caller.
_transfer compares the resulting balance against LockedTokens[_from].
_transfer uses SafeMath.sub to debit the sender balance.
_transfer uses SafeMath.add to credit the recipient balance.
The SafeMath.add result is written into balanceOf[_to]; overflow is guarded by require(c >= a).
The SafeMath.sub result is written into balanceOf[_from]; underflow is guarded by require(b <= a).
_approve writes the allowance into the _allowance mapping.
transfer delegates the token movement to _transfer.
burn checks LockList[msg.sender] before burning.
burn compares the remaining balance with LockedTokens[msg.sender].
burn debits balanceOf[msg.sender].
burn reduces totalSupply by the burned amount.
burn uses SafeMath.sub for the balance and supply subtractions.
burnFrom checks LockList for both the caller and the target account.
burnFrom compares the remaining balance with LockedTokens[Account].
burnFrom reads and rewrites the caller allowance in _allowance.
burnFrom debits balanceOf[Account].
burnFrom reduces totalSupply.
burnFrom calls _approve to lower the spender allowance.
burnFrom uses SafeMath.sub for allowance, balance and supply arithmetic.
transferFrom calls _transfer before touching the allowance.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrease the caller allowance.
transferFrom reads and writes _allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub to reduce the allowance.
approve reads balanceOf[msg.sender] to derive the unapproved remainder.
approve compares the remainder against LockedTokens[msg.sender].
approve writes the new allowance into _allowance.
approve performs an unconditional allowance overwrite.
The overwrite of _allowance enables the approve front-running race condition.
approve uses SafeMath.sub to compute the unapproved balance.
approveAndCall first calls approve for the spender.
approveAndCall invokes an external callback on an attacker-controlled recipient.
tokenRecipient.receiveApproval can re-enter the token functions before the call context settles.
approveAndCall updates the allowance of the untrusted spender through approve.
allowance returns the stored value from _allowance.
UserLock writes the lock flag into LockList[Account].
LockTokens writes the locked amount into LockedTokens[Account].
UnLockTokens resets LockedTokens[Account] to zero.
